question: Which team was the Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) Season 8 winner?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dabang Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Pro Kabaddi League's eighth season began on December 22 at the Sheraton Grand Bengaluru Whitefield Hotel & Convention Centre in Bengaluru.
 
• Dabang Delhi KC clinched the Pro Kabaddi League Season 8 trophy by eking out a close 37-36 win over Patna Pirates in the summit clash.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• Pro Kabaddi League (known as Vivo Pro Kabaddi for sponsorship reasons) is a men's professional Kabaddi league from India.
 
• It was launched in 2014 and is aired on Star Sports.
